results.question: List all districts
results.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM districts
results.generated_sql: SELECT id, name, area_km2, population, budget FROM districts ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

results.question: Show all camera locations
results.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM camera_locations
results.generated_sql: SELECT * FROM camera_locations LIMIT 100

results.question: How many zones are there?
results.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zones
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_zones FROM zones LIMIT 100

results.question: List all violation types
results.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT violation_type FROM violations
results.generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT violation_type FROM violations ORDER BY violation_type LIMIT 100

results.question: Show only approved infrastructure projects
results.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM infrastructure_projects WHERE status = 'Approved'
results.generated_sql: SELECT * FROM infrastructure_projects WHERE status = 'completed' LIMIT 100

results.question: Which cameras are of type speed?
results.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM camera_locations WHERE camera_type = 'speed'
results.generated_sql: SELECT id, location_desc, camera_type FROM camera_locations WHERE camera_type = 'speed' LIMIT 100

results.question: Show incidents that are still ongoing
results.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE status = 'Ongoing'
results.generated_sql: SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE status IN ('open', 'in_progress') LIMIT 100

results.question: List roads with more than 3 lanes
results.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM roads WHERE lanes > 3
results.generated_sql: SELECT road_name, lanes FROM roads WHERE lanes > 3 LIMIT 100

results.question: How many traffic violations happened in each district?
results.expected_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(*) as total FROM violations v JOIN camera_locations cl ON v.camera_id = cl.id JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id JOIN districts d ON r.district_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id
results.generated_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(*) as total_violations FROM violations v JOIN camera_locations cl ON v.camera_id = cl.id JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id JOIN districts d ON r.district_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY total_violations DESC LIMIT 100

results.question: What is the average vehicle count per zone?
results.expected_sql: SELECT z.name, AVG(tr.vehicle_count) FROM traffic_readings tr JOIN camera_locations cl ON tr.camera_id = cl.id JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id JOIN zones z ON r.zone_id = z.id GROUP BY z.id
results.generated_sql: SELECT z.name, AVG(tr.vehicle_count) as avg_vehicle_count FROM traffic_readings tr JOIN camera_locations cl ON tr.camera_id = cl.id JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id JOIN zones z ON r.zone_id = z.id GROUP BY z.name ORDER BY avg_vehicle_count DESC LIMIT 100

results.question: What is the total budget of all infrastructure projects?
results.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(budget) FROM infrastructure_projects
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(budget) as total_budget FROM infrastructure_projects LIMIT 100

results.question: How many incidents were reported per severity level?
results.expected_sql: SELECT severity, COUNT(*) FROM incidents GROUP BY severity
results.generated_sql: SELECT severity, COUNT(*) as total_incidents FROM incidents GROUP BY severity ORDER BY total_incidents DESC LIMIT 100

results.question: Show cameras and which road they are on
results.expected_sql: SELECT cl.location_desc, r.road_name FROM camera_locations cl JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id
results.generated_sql: SELECT cl.location_desc, cl.camera_type, r.road_name FROM camera_locations cl JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id LIMIT 100

results.question: List districts and how many roads each has
results.expected_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(r.id) FROM districts d JOIN roads r ON d.id = r.district_id GROUP BY d.id
results.generated_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(r.id) as total_roads FROM districts d JOIN roads r ON d.id = r.district_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY total_roads DESC LIMIT 100

results.question: Show air quality readings with zone names
results.expected_sql: SELECT z.name, w.pm25, w.pm10, w.recorded_at FROM weather_data w JOIN zones z ON w.zone_id = z.id WHERE w.data_type = 'air_quality'
results.generated_sql: SELECT wd.id, z.name, wd.recorded_at, wd.data_type, wd.temperature, wd.humidity, wd.wind_speed, wd.pm25, wd.pm10, wd.air_quality_index, wd.weather_condition FROM weather_data wd JOIN zones z ON wd.zone_id = z.id LIMIT 100

results.question: Which district has the most camera locations?
results.expected_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(cl.id) as camera_count FROM districts d JOIN roads r ON d.id = r.district_id JOIN camera_locations cl ON r.id = cl.road_id GROUP BY d.id ORDER BY camera_count DESC LIMIT 1
results.generated_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(cl.id) as total_camera_locations FROM districts d JOIN roads r ON d.id = r.district_id JOIN camera_locations cl ON r.id = cl.road_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY total_camera_locations DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Which camera detects the most violations?
results.expected_sql: SELECT cl.location_desc, cl.camera_type, COUNT(*) as total_violations FROM violations v JOIN camera_locations cl ON v.camera_id = cl.id GROUP BY cl.id ORDER BY total_violations DESC LIMIT 1
results.generated_sql: SELECT cl.location_desc, cl.camera_type, COUNT(*) as total_violations FROM violations v JOIN camera_locations cl ON v.camera_id = cl.id GROUP BY cl.id ORDER BY total_violations DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Show the average speed per road during peak hours
results.expected_sql: SELECT r.road_name, AVG(tr.avg_speed) FROM traffic_readings tr JOIN camera_locations cl ON tr.camera_id = cl.id JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id WHERE tr.is_peak_hour = 1 GROUP BY r.id
results.generated_sql: SELECT r.road_name, AVG(tr.avg_speed) as avg_speed FROM traffic_readings tr JOIN camera_locations cl ON tr.camera_id = cl.id JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id WHERE tr.is_peak_hour = 1 GROUP BY r.road_name HAVING AVG(tr.avg_speed) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY avg_speed DESC LIMIT 100

results.question: What is the total fine amount per violation type?
results.expected_sql: SELECT violation_type, SUM(fine_amount) as total_fines FROM violations GROUP BY violation_type ORDER BY total_fines DESC
results.generated_sql: SELECT violation_type, SUM(fine_amount) as total_fine FROM violations GROUP BY violation_type ORDER BY total_fine DESC LIMIT 100

results.question: Which districts have infrastructure projects with budget over 500000?
results.expected_sql: SELECT d.name, ip.project_name, ip.budget FROM infrastructure_projects ip JOIN districts d ON ip.district_id = d.id WHERE ip.budget > 500000
results.generated_sql: SELECT d.name FROM districts d JOIN infrastructure_projects ip ON d.id = ip.district_id WHERE ip.budget > 500000 GROUP BY d.name LIMIT 100

results.question: Which zone has the worst air quality (highest PM2.5)?
results.expected_sql: SELECT z.name, MAX(w.pm25) as max_pm25 FROM weather_data w JOIN zones z ON w.zone_id = z.id WHERE w.data_type = 'air_quality' GROUP BY z.id ORDER BY max_pm25 DESC LIMIT 1
results.generated_sql: SELECT z.name, wd.pm25 AS pm25_level FROM weather_data wd JOIN zones z ON wd.zone_id = z.id ORDER BY wd.pm25 DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Show districts with both incidents and violations
results.expected_sql: SELECT d.name FROM districts d WHERE d.id IN (SELECT r.district_id FROM roads r JOIN camera_locations cl ON r.id = cl.road_id JOIN violations v ON cl.id = v.camera_id) AND d.id IN (SELECT district_id FROM incidents)
results.generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.name FROM districts d JOIN incidents i ON d.id = i.district_id JOIN camera_locations cl ON d.id = cl.road_id JOIN violations v ON cl.id = v.camera_id WHERE i.incident_type IS NOT NULL AND v.violation_type IS NOT NULL LIMIT 100

results.question: What is the average response time for incidents per district?
results.expected_sql: SELECT d.name, AVG(i.response_time_minutes) FROM incidents i JOIN districts d ON i.district_id = d.id WHERE i.response_time_minutes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.id
results.generated_sql: SELECT d.name, AVG(i.response_time_minutes) as avg_response_time FROM incidents i JOIN districts d ON i.district_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name HAVING AVG(i.response_time_minutes) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY avg_response_time ASC LIMIT 100

results.question: List roads with above-average congestion level
results.expected_sql: SELECT r.road_name, AVG(tr.congestion_level) as avg_congestion FROM traffic_readings tr JOIN camera_locations cl ON tr.camera_id = cl.id JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id GROUP BY r.id HAVING AVG(tr.congestion_level) > (SELECT AVG(congestion_level) FROM traffic_readings)
results.generated_sql: SELECT r.road_name, AVG(tr.congestion_level) as avg_congestion FROM roads r JOIN camera_locations cl ON r.id = cl.road_id JOIN traffic_readings tr ON cl.id = tr.camera_id GROUP BY r.id HAVING AVG(CASE WHEN tr.congestion_level = 'high' THEN 1 WHEN tr.congestion_level = 'severe' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) > (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN congestion_level = 'high' THEN 1 WHEN congestion_level = 'severe' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) FROM traffic_readings) LIMIT 100

results.question: Rank zones by their average air quality index
results.expected_sql: SELECT z.name, AVG(w.air_quality_index) as avg_aqi, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(w.air_quality_index) DESC) as rank FROM weather_data w JOIN zones z ON w.zone_id = z.id WHERE w.air_quality_index IS NOT NULL GROUP BY z.id
results.generated_sql: SELECT z.name, AVG(w.air_quality_index) as avg_air_quality_index FROM zones z JOIN weather_data w ON z.id = w.zone_id GROUP BY z.name ORDER BY avg_air_quality_index DESC LIMIT 100

results.question: Show the running total of violations per day
results.expected_sql: SELECT DATE(violation_time) as day, COUNT(*) as daily_count, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE(violation_time)) as running_total FROM violations GROUP BY DATE(violation_time)
results.generated_sql: SELECT DATE(violation_time) AS date, SUM(fine_amount) AS total_fine, COUNT(*) AS total_violations FROM violations GROUP BY DATE(violation_time) ORDER BY date LIMIT 100

results.question: Find the busiest camera in each district
results.expected_sql: SELECT d.name, cl.location_desc, COUNT(v.id) as violation_count FROM violations v JOIN camera_locations cl ON v.camera_id = cl.id JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id JOIN districts d ON r.district_id = d.id GROUP BY cl.id ORDER BY d.name, violation_count DESC
results.generated_sql: SELECT d.name, cl.location_desc, COUNT(*) as total_violations FROM violations v JOIN camera_locations cl ON v.camera_id = cl.id JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id JOIN districts d ON r.district_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name, cl.location_desc ORDER BY d.name, total_violations DESC LIMIT 100

results.question: Compare total violations this month vs last month per district
results.expected_sql: SELECT d.name, SUM(CASE WHEN v.violation_time >= date('now', 'start of month') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as this_month, SUM(CASE WHEN v.violation_time < date('now', 'start of month') AND v.violation_time >= date('now', 'start of month', '-1 month') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as last_month FROM violations v JOIN camera_locations cl ON v.camera_id = cl.id JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id JOIN districts d ON r.district_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id
results.generated_sql: SELECT d.name, SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y-%m', v.violation_time) = STRFTIME('%Y-%m', DATE('now')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS this_month, SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y-%m', v.violation_time) = STRFTIME('%Y-%m', DATE('now', '-1 month')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_month FROM violations v JOIN camera_locations cl ON v.camera_id = cl.id JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id JOIN districts d ON r.district_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY d.name LIMIT 100

results.question: Use a CTE to show district summaries with total violations, incidents, and projects
results.expected_sql: WITH v AS (SELECT d.id, COUNT(*) as total_violations FROM violations v JOIN camera_locations cl ON v.camera_id = cl.id JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id JOIN districts d ON r.district_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id), i AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) as total_incidents FROM incidents GROUP BY district_id), p AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) as total_projects FROM infrastructure_projects GROUP BY district_id) SELECT d.name, COALESCE(v.total_violations, 0), COALESCE(i.total_incidents, 0), COALESCE(p.total_projects, 0) FROM districts d LEFT JOIN v ON d.id = v.id LEFT JOIN i ON d.id = i.district_id LEFT JOIN p ON d.id = p.district_id
results.generated_sql: SELECT d.name, COALESCE(v.total_violations, 0) AS total_violations, COALESCE(i.total_incidents, 0) AS total_incidents, COALESCE(p.total_projects, 0) AS total_projects FROM districts d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS total_violations FROM ( SELECT cl.road_id, v.id FROM violations v JOIN camera_locations cl ON v.camera_id = cl.id ) AS sub JOIN roads r ON sub.road_id = r.id GROUP BY district_id ) v ON d.id = v.district_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS total_incidents FROM incidents GROUP BY district_id ) i ON d.id = i.district_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS total_projects FROM infrastructure_projects GROUP BY district_id ) p ON d.id = p.district_id ORDER BY d.name LIMIT 100

results.question: Show weather data trends - compare air quality between zones using a subquery
results.expected_sql: SELECT z.name, AVG(w.air_quality_index) as avg_aqi FROM weather_data w JOIN zones z ON w.zone_id = z.id WHERE w.air_quality_index IS NOT NULL GROUP BY z.id HAVING AVG(w.air_quality_index) > (SELECT AVG(air_quality_index) FROM weather_data WHERE air_quality_index IS NOT NULL)
results.generated_sql: SELECT z.name, AVG(wd.air_quality_index) as avg_air_quality FROM zones z JOIN weather_data wd ON z.id = wd.zone_id WHERE wd.data_type = 'air_quality' GROUP BY z.name HAVING AVG(wd.air_quality_index) > ( SELECT AVG(air_quality_index) FROM weather_data WHERE data_type = 'air_quality' ) ORDER BY avg_air_quality DESC LIMIT 100
